data.action: 双手轻柔捧起你的脸颊，金发在海风中纷飞，霞光染透湛蓝眼眸，探头微吻
data.camera: medium close-up, dramatic sunset bokeh, wind swept hair, profound emotional confession
data.description: 漫天如梦似幻的粉紫晚霞映照着翻涌的金色海浪。薇尔莉特身着白色夏日连身裙，海风吹散了她编起的发辫，金色长发在霞光中如金色缎带般漫天起伏。她抬起冰凉而精致的银色机械双手，小心翼翼地捧起你的脸庞，在两唇相碰前，轻声诉说着她一生唯一的誓言。
data.lighting: 粉紫与暖金交融的梦幻落日晚霞，水面波光粼粼的逆光反光
data.location: 海滨灯塔旁的白色大理石观海露台
data.promptProse: On the sea-cliff terrace, Violet lifts both silver hands to the face of the man opposite her. His short dark hair and open navy collar are outlined by the pink-violet sunset, while the sea wind lifts her loose blond hair above her white summer dress. Their faces pause a breath apart.
data.title: 薇尔莉特 · 海崖晚霞的指尖抚触
data.identityProseOverride: Violet Evergarden, an Auto Memories Doll with loose golden-blonde hair, red hair ribbons, blue eyes and articulated silver prosthetic hands.
data.animaCaption: Violet's loose blond hair streams off her white-dressed shoulder as her silver hands cup the short dark-haired man's cheeks. His open navy collar sits under their near-kiss.
